subject: Large Dagger
text: A treasure chest down the northern stairs of the Marsh Cave contains a Large Dagger.

evidence.quote: From the start of the cave, head north till you see a staircase leading down. Once down here, pick up the treasure boxes which contain a Large Dagger, Short Sword, and 1300 GP in them.

subject: 1300 GP

evidence.quote: In the buildings along the first row, (near the staircase leading back up and leading left to right) is an Iron Armor, the second building is empty, as is the third room.

subject: Crown

evidence.quote: In the second room, you'll find the Crown but you'll have to fight 2-6 Wizards for it (see below for more info).

subject: Astos
text: Astos has 168 HP and no elemental weakness.

evidence.quote:
Boss: Astos

HP: 168
Weakness: None

subject: Astos
text: Astos can cast Rub as a one-hit kill spell, as well as Fast, Fir2, Slo2, and Sleep.

evidence.quote: Astos isn't too tough to beat, but he does have a few nasty spells to his disposal including the Rub spell which is a one hit kill spell when it succeeds, and he can also use spells such as Fast and Fir2, along with Slo2 and Sleep.

subject: Astos
text: Against Astos, cast Fast on hard-hitting physical attackers while the White Mage attempts to cast Mute.

evidence.quote: I have my Fighters, Thieves and Black Belts attack Astos, while I have the Red and Black Mage cast Fast on the Fighter and any other hard hitting character you may have. I try to have the White Mage Mute Astos, sometimes it works othertimes not.

subject: Astos
text: Talking to Astos in Astos' Castle causes him to demand the Crown back and attack the party to yield the Crystal.

evidence.quote: Your main goal is to defeat Astos for the Crystal. As soon as you talk to Astos he demands his Crown back and immediatly proceeds to attack the party.

subject: Crystal
text: Talking to Motoya in her cave allows you to trade the Crystal for the Herb used to wake the Prince.

evidence.quote: Enter the cave, and talk to Motoya. She will trade the Herb to wake the Prince in exchange for your Crystal with which she uses for sight.

subject: Sleeping Prince
text: Giving the Herb to the attendant next to the sleeping Prince in Elfland Castle awakens the Prince and awards the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote: Enter the castle and talk to the person next to the Prince, and he gives him the Herb and will awaken the Prince. You then receive the Mystic Key, with which you now open up a few extra treasure boxes for you to get.

subject: Nerrick
text: Giving TNT to Nerrick in Dwarf Cave allows him to construct a Canal south of the cave to open passage to Melmond.

evidence.quote:
There isn't a lot to be done here, other than go on a massive looting
raid on the treasure room, and to give your TNT to a dwarf named
Nerrick who will use it to make a Canal just south of the cave, which
will allow you passage to Melmond and other lands to the west of the
area in which you were limited too.

subject: Life
text: The Life spell revives a character with only 1 HP and cannot be used in battle.

evidence.quote: One little side note about the Life spell. It will revive a character with only 1 HP and thus they'll need to be healed afterwards, and it will not work in battle, and attempting to do so will only deplete your magic for level five and also be ineffective at the same time.

subject: Town of Melmond
text: Melmond lacks an Item Shop and a Clinic, requiring players to stock up on potions in Elfland and travel back to revive fallen allies.

evidence.quote:
Before heading any further, you'll have to head back to Elfland and buy
some Houses and Soft Potions along with Cabins, Pure and Heal Potions
if you need them as there isn't an Item Shop in Melmond. Also be
warned, there is not a Clinic here either, so you'll have to travel
back in order to revive defeated members.

subject: Hall of Giants
text: Straight west from the beginning of Earth Cave along the western wall is the hall of giants, where every step triggers a fight with 1-4 giants and Iguanas.

evidence.quote: There is a good place for making gold and exp in this cave and its known as the hall of giants. Each step will amount in a fight with 1-4 giants along with Iguanas....It is straight west from the beginning of the cave, and extends mostly along the western wall.
